## Activity

During December 2019, Central Eye Clinic recorded 126 captures. This represents the activity completed at the site during the month. The recorded volume provides the basis for the image quality review and subsequent grading outcomes. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during this period.

## Image quality

Of the 126 captures, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.4 per cent. This result should continue to be monitored as part of routine site operations, with attention given to maintaining consistent image capture and ensuring that images are suitable for grading wherever possible.

## Grading

A total of 24 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 2 days. These figures summarise the grading activity associated with the December 2019 workload at Central Eye Clinic. The results should be considered alongside the image quality findings, including the 3 ungradable captures and the ungradable rate of 2.4 per cent.
